tier_justification: Preservation of individual formula and temporal classes across homomorphisms, bounded morphisms, simulations, and trace inclusion is classical; unifying all twenty-one directional pipeline boundary relations (separating plain surjective homomorphisms from positive bounded morphisms) and five positive claim shapes over negation-free propositional state formulas into a single decidable epistemic status transformer `transfer` on Kripke structures is parameterized here.
plain_claim: For every boundary relation `rel : BoundaryRel`, positive claim shape `sh : PosShape`, negation-free positive propositional state formula `P : Spec`, and Kripke systems `src tgt : Sys`: if `Realizes rel src tgt` holds, then `transfer rel sh (statusOf src sh P)` is below or equal to `statusOf tgt sh P` in the epistemic information order `Status.le`.

hypotheses.name: hrel : Realizes rel src tgt
hypotheses.purpose: witnesses that the semantic link declared by `rel` actually holds between `src` and `tgt`
hypotheses.witness_class: two 1-state Kripke systems `constSys valTrue` and `constSys valFalse` paired under `.termRoundTrip` at `.univSafety` and `specAtom0`

nonvacuity_witness: `nonvacuity_transfer_sound`: `constSys valTrue` realizes `.lockStepSim .s2m` to itself and preserves `.supported` on `.hyperSubsetClosed` at `specAtom0`.
non_claims: When `transfer rel sh st = .undetermined`, `Status.le .undetermined (statusOf tgt sh P)` holds trivially without constraining `tgt`'s verdict; completeness of `.undetermined` is established separately in `transfer_undetermined_sharp`.

Every `Sys` has a non-empty initial state set (`init_nonempty`) and a total transition relation (`step_total`), ensuring every system admits at least one infinite execution (`hasTrace_nonempty`); systems with empty initial sets or deadlocked finite-only runs are not modeled.

`BoundaryRel.surjHom` (`IsSurjHomFrom`) models plain surjective positive homomorphisms without transition back-lifting and preserves `.supported` on `.existWitness` (`isHomFrom_preserves_existWitness`), whereas plain surjective (even bijective, exact-valuation) homomorphisms without step back-lifting fail to preserve `.univSafety` and `.termination` over execution traces (`surjHom_breaks_trace_univSafety_and_termination`); preserving `.univSafety` and `.termination` forward requires `BoundaryRel.posBoundedMorph` (`IsPosBoundedMorphFrom`, a positive bounded morphism / p-morphism with `init` and `step` back-lifting).

Inside `Basic.lean`, `CertPinnedLink`, `RoundTripLink`, `LitEntailsLink`, and `CospanSysWitness` summarize cross-system semantic links on `Sys`: `CertPinnedLink` instantiates a `CertFaithful`, `CertSemSound`, `TablePinned` verifier over `Sys` and reduces to trace equivalence (`certPinnedLink_iff_traceEquiv`), `RoundTripLink` requires a left-inverse `print`/`elabTerm` section over trace-equivalent presentations and reduces to trace equivalence (`roundTripLink_iff_traceEquiv`), `LitEntailsLink` assumes positive `EvalShape` entailment (`∀ sh P, EvalShape sh src P → EvalShape sh tgt P`) directly, and `CospanSysWitness ir exec` reduces to `TraceIncl exec ir` (`cospanSysWitness_iff_traceIncl`); concrete polymorphic certificate and cospan hypotheses are analyzed separately in `cert_trust_triple_sound` and `cospan_subsetClosed_transfer`.

`Spec` ranges over negation-free positive propositional state formulas (`top`, `bot`, `atom`, `conj`, `disj`) and cannot negate a single atom (`v a = false`); because `IsHomFrom`, `IsSurjHomFrom`, and `IsPosBoundedMorphFrom` preserve only positive truth (`evalVal_mono`), universal absence of a positive bad-event atom (`∀ τ n, v bad = false`) is not preserved forward along `.posBoundedMorph .m2s` or `.surjHom .m2s` (`isPosBoundedMorphFrom_to_constValTrue`, `isSurjHomFrom_to_constValTrue`).

`EvalShape` evaluates single representative schemas — state invariants (`∀ τ n, evalVal P (τ n) = true`) for `.univSafety`, eventual formula visit (`∀ τ, ∃ n, evalVal P (τ n) = true`) on total infinite runs for `.termination`, all-step 2-safety observational determinism (`∀ τ₁ τ₂, evalVal P (τ₁ 0) = evalVal P (τ₂ 0) → ∀ n, evalVal P (τ₁ n) = evalVal P (τ₂ n)`) for `.hyperSubsetClosed`, and any-step two-trace variation (`∀ τ₁, ∃ τ₂, evalVal P (τ₂ 0) = evalVal P (τ₁ 0) ∧ ∃ n, evalVal P (τ₂ n) ≠ evalVal P (τ₁ n)`) for `.hyperGeneral` — rather than arbitrary prefix-closed safety properties, finite-run halting, or arbitrary subset-closed/`∀∃` hyperproperties.

tier_justification: Individual separations among existential reachability, universal safety, termination under stuttering, synchronous 2-safety, and generalized noninterference are standard; organizing them into an explicit `5 × 5` upper-triangular transfer matrix paired with `Sys` sub-diagonal countermodels and pairwise `PosShape` column distinctness is made precise here.
plain_claim: Ordering the five boundary relations via `sepRel` (`.litEntails`, `.lockStepSim .s2m`, `.wfStutterSim .s2m`, `.stutterSim .s2m`, `.embed .m2s`) and the five positive claim shapes via `sepShape` (`.hyperGeneral`, `.hyperSubsetClosed`, `.termination`, `.univSafety`, `.existWitness`), every diagonal cell `(i, i)` maps `.supported` to `.supported` under `transfer` and every strict sub-diagonal cell `(i, j)` with `j.1 < i.1` maps `.supported` to `.undetermined` (`sepMatrix_upperTriangular`) and admits a concrete `Realizes (sepRel i) src tgt` Kripke pair flipping `.supported` to `.contradicted` at `specAtom0` (`sepMatrix_subdiagonal_countermodels`); consequently, whenever `sh₁ ≠ sh₂`, some `BoundaryRel` separates `sh₁` and `sh₂` on `.supported` (`posShape_columns_pairwise_distinct`).

hypotheses.name: hlt : j.1 < i.1
hypotheses.purpose: restricts countermodel construction to strict sub-diagonal entries `(i, j)` where `sepRel i` does not preserve `sepShape j`
hypotheses.witness_class: diagonal index `i = j = ⟨0, _⟩` (`.litEntails`, `.hyperGeneral`), where `transfer_sound` preserves `.supported`

hypotheses.name: hne : sh₁ ≠ sh₂
hypotheses.purpose: excludes identical shapes whose `transfer` column values coincide on every `BoundaryRel`
hypotheses.witness_class: `sh₁ = sh₂ = .univSafety`, where `transfer rel .univSafety .supported` equals itself for all `rel`

nonvacuity_witness: `nonvacuity_posShape_distinct`: `(⟨1, _⟩ : Fin 5).1 < (⟨2, _⟩ : Fin 5).1` and `.termination ≠ .hyperSubsetClosed`, with `.wfStutterSim .s2m` mapping `.supported` to `.supported` on `.termination` and to `.undetermined` on `.hyperSubsetClosed`.
non_claims: Upper-triangularity holds for the listed row and column orderings `sepRel` and `sepShape` on `.supported`; super-diagonal entries `j > i` are not all `.supported` (for instance, `.lockStepSim .s2m` maps `.existWitness` `.supported` to `.undetermined`).

Distinctness of the five `PosShape` columns does not imply that all twenty-one `BoundaryRel` rows are pairwise distinct under `transfer` (for example, `.lockStepSim .s2m`, `.traceRefine .s2m`, `.embed .s2m`, and `.cospanCaptureLower` share the same trace-refinement transfer row) (by inspection of `preservesDefinite`; not proved as a separate theorem here).

`transfer (.wfStutterSim .s2m) .hyperSubsetClosed .supported = .undetermined` reflects step-index sensitivity of `EvalShape .hyperSubsetClosed` (`∀ n, evalVal P (τ₁ n) = evalVal P (τ₂ n)` under synchronous step indexing); stutter-invariant subset-closed hyperproperties are not refuted under well-founded stuttering simulation (not proved here).

Row `0` (`.litEntails`) preserves `.hyperGeneral` because `LitEntailsLink` assumes `∀ sh P, EvalShape sh src P → EvalShape sh tgt P` directly by definition, not via a structural morphism on states or transitions.

tier_justification: Countermodels for individual unlicensed cells (such as refinement breaking GNI or unranked stuttering breaking termination) are classical; uniform sharpness across all 210 `(BoundaryRel, PosShape, definite Status)` cells for every non-degenerate negation-free positive formula `P : Spec` is proved here.
plain_claim: For every boundary relation `rel : BoundaryRel`, positive shape `sh : PosShape`, positive propositional formula `P : Spec`, and verdict `st : Status`: if `NonDegen sh P` holds, `st.Definite` holds (`st = .supported ∨ st = .contradicted`), and `transfer rel sh st = .undetermined`, then there exist Kripke systems `src₁, tgt₁, src₂, tgt₂ : Sys` realizing `rel` (`Realizes rel src₁ tgt₁` and `Realizes rel src₂ tgt₂`) such that both `src₁` and `src₂` have verdict `st` for `(sh, P)`, `tgt₁` has verdict `.supported`, and `tgt₂` has verdict `.contradicted`.

hypotheses.name: hnd : NonDegen sh P
hypotheses.purpose: ensures `(sh, P)` admits both `.supported` and `.contradicted` Kripke systems (`evalVal P valFalse = false ∧ evalVal P valTrue = true`) rather than a constant tautology or contradiction
hypotheses.witness_class: the tautological formula `specConstTrue` at `.none`, `.univSafety`, and `.supported`, where no Kripke system is `.contradicted`

hypotheses.name: hdef : st.Definite
hypotheses.purpose: restricts the source verdict `st` to `.supported` or `.contradicted`, since `statusOf` on a Kripke system is two-valued and never equals `.undetermined`
hypotheses.witness_class: `st = .undetermined` at `.none`, `.univSafety`, and `specAtom0`, where no `src₁ : Sys` has `statusOf src₁ = .undetermined`

hypotheses.name: hund : transfer rel sh st = .undetermined
hypotheses.purpose: excludes preserved cells where `transfer_sound` forces every target `tgt` to share verdict `st`
hypotheses.witness_class: the sound cell `.lockStepSim .s2m`, `.univSafety`, `.supported` at `specAtom0`, where no realized target can be `.contradicted`

non_claims: Sharpness constructs finite Kripke countermodels (`constSys`, `stepSys`, `twoBranchSys`, `threeBranchSys`, `finiteStutterSys`) over `Sys`; restricting `Sys` to a narrower subclass (for example, `TraceDeterministic` systems) can validate additional transfers not licensed in general (`determinizing_stage_breaks_markovian_completeness`).

Sharpness of `transfer .litEntails sh .contradicted = .undetermined` relies on `Spec` containing only negation-free positive propositional state formulas (`evalVal_mono`); if `LitEntailsLink` quantified over negation-closed state predicates `Valuation → Bool`, dualizing `p` with `fun v => !p v` would force universal entailment to preserve `.contradicted` on both `.univSafety` and `.existWitness` (`negation_closed_entailment_preserves_contradicted`).

For `.hyperSubsetClosed`, `EvalShape` evaluates synchronous all-step 2-safety observational determinism (`evalVal P (τ₁ 0) = evalVal P (τ₂ 0) → ∀ n, evalVal P (τ₁ n) = evalVal P (τ₂ n)`), which is broken by finite stuttering (`finiteStutterSys`); stutter-invariant subset-closed properties such as `.univSafety` are already covered by the `.univSafety` column.

plain_claim: For every boundary relation `rel : BoundaryRel`, paired directional claim-shape tuple `sh : PosShape × PosShape`, positive formulas `P₁ P₂ : Spec`, and Kripke systems `src tgt : Sys`: if `Realizes rel src tgt` holds, then each component of `transferIff rel sh (statusOf src sh.1 P₁, statusOf src sh.2 P₂)` bounds the corresponding component status of `tgt` under `Status.le` (`transferIff_sound`); `transferIff rel (.univSafety, .existWitness) (.supported, .supported)` equals `(.supported, .supported)` iff `rel` is `.posBoundedMorph .m2s`, `.certFaithfulSoundPinned`, `.termRoundTrip`, or `.litEntails` (`transferIff_univSafety_existWitness_supported_iff`), whereas there exist `src, tgt` realizing `.lockStepSim .s2m` where `src` supports `.univSafety` at `specAtom0` and `.existWitness` at `specAtom1` while `tgt` preserves `.univSafety` at `specAtom0` and falsifies `.existWitness` at that same `specAtom1` (`cex_iff_converse_unlicensed`).

hypotheses.witness_class: there is an even-number checker `c` on `F = [0]` with `L d := d 2 = true` probing `2 ∉ F`

hypotheses.name: hlaw : L c
hypotheses.purpose: supplies satisfaction of `L` on the original checker `c`
hypotheses.witness_class: `L = fun _ => False` on `F = [0]` and `c = (· % 2 == 0)`

hypotheses.name: hout : ∃ p : α, p ∉ F ∧ c p = true
hypotheses.purpose: ensures `suiteAllowlist F c` actually differs extensionally from `c` on at least one accepted input outside `F` (automatically valid under `hsound` by `outside_accepted_good_iff`)
hypotheses.witness_class: `good = (· = 0)` and `c = (· == 0)` on `F = [0]`, where `suiteAllowlist [0] c = c`

nonvacuity_witness: `nonvacuity_finite_suite_barrier`: `good = (· % 2 = 0)`, `c = (· % 2 == 0)`, `F = [0]`, `L d := CheckerSound good d ∧ d 0 = true`, and outside witness `p = 2`.
non_claims: The barrier applies to a fixed finite suite `F` chosen before the checker is frozen; evaluating `c` on held-out or post-freeze valid artifacts outside `F` breaks `SuiteSoundInvariant` and separates `c` from `suiteAllowlist F c` (`positive_control_postFreeze_probe_separates`).

Universal relational or metamorphic checker laws across unbounded inputs (for example, monotonicity or equivalence-invariance `∀ x y, rel x y → c x = true → c y = true`) and proof-certificate obligations depend on behavior outside `F`, violate `SuiteSoundInvariant`, and are not subject to `finite_suite_allowlist_barrier` (not proved here).
Over bounded finite state spaces where `F` enumerates every accepted input (`∀ p, c p = true → p ∈ F`), `suiteAllowlist F c` equals `c` (`cex_suite_barrier_without_outside_witness`).

tier_justification: Elementary intensional-representation reference point: restates extensional lookup-wrapper indistinguishability (`sound-checker-laws-...` `R3a`) over explicit `ImplChecker α Code` pairs so `ImplExtensionalLaw` does not collapse trivially under Lean function extensionality on bare `α → Bool`.
plain_claim: For every decidable-equality type `α`, representation type `Code`, law `L : ImplChecker α Code → Prop`, representations `code₁ code₂ : Code`, checker `c : α → Bool`, and lookup table `table : List (α × Bool)`: if `ImplExtensionalLaw L`, `TableConsistentWith table c`, and `L ⟨code₁, c⟩` hold, then `L ⟨code₂, lookupWrapper table c⟩` holds and `code₁ ≠ code₂` implies `⟨code₂, lookupWrapper table c⟩ ≠ ⟨code₁, c⟩`.

hypotheses.name: hext : ImplExtensionalLaw L
hypotheses.purpose: prevents `L` from inspecting `ImplChecker.code` directly rather than input-output behavior `run`
hypotheses.witness_class: `L chk := chk.code = true` separating `code₁ = true` from `code₂ = false`

hypotheses.name: hcons : TableConsistentWith table c
hypotheses.purpose: ensures every cached entry in `table` agrees with `c` so `lookupWrapper table c` has identical `run` behavior
hypotheses.witness_class: there is an inconsistent entry `[(1, true)]` wrapping `c = (· == 0)` under `L chk := CheckerSound (· = 0) chk.run`

hypotheses.name: hlaw : L ⟨code₁, c⟩
hypotheses.purpose: supplies satisfaction of `L` on the original implementation `⟨code₁, c⟩`
hypotheses.witness_class: `L = fun _ => False` with `table = [(0, true)]` and `c = (· == 0)`

nonvacuity_witness: `nonvacuity_extensional_lookupWrapper`: on `L chk := CheckerSound (· = 0) chk.run ∧ chk.run 0 = true`, `c = (· == 0)`, `table = [(0, true)]`, `code₁ = true`, and `code₂ = false`, all three hypotheses (`ImplExtensionalLaw L`, `TableConsistentWith table c`, `L ⟨true, c⟩`) and `true ≠ false` hold jointly.
non_claims: `lookupWrapper table c` retains the full fallback checker `c` for every input absent from `table` (and when `code₁ = code₂`, `⟨code, lookupWrapper table c⟩ = ⟨code, c⟩` by `lookupWrapper_same_code_eq`); `extensional_law_admits_lookupWrapper` establishes extensional indistinguishability of fronting `c` with a consistent memoization cache, not that a standalone finite lookup table without `c` can match `c` over an unbounded input domain.

Intensional or certificate-emitting requirements that inspect `code` or require independently checkable proof objects (`positive_control_intensional_code_law_separates`, `cert_trust_triple_sound`) are not `ImplExtensionalLaw` and DO separate compositional checkers from lookup-wrapped representations.

tier_justification: Elementary re-derivation of sound-and-complete boolean decision equivalence (`sound-checker-laws-...` `R6c`) paired with conservative fast-path filtering (`warnAdjudicateGate`), explicitly recording the four tightness obligations separating hard `blockingGate` lockout from `warn + adjudicate`.
plain_claim: For every artifact type `α`, semantic validity predicate `P : α → Prop`, and boolean check `Q : α → Bool`: `blockingGate Q` achieves both `ZeroLockout P` and `ZeroFalseAccept P` iff `∀ x, Q x = true ↔ P x` (`zeroLockout_and_zeroFalseAccept_iff_exact`); if `P x₀` and `Q x₀ = false` hold for some `x₀ : α`, then `blockingGate Q x₀ = false` and `ZeroLockout P (blockingGate Q)` fails (`blockingGate_locks_out_strict_proxy`), whereas if `ExactAdjudicatorOnWarnings P Q adj` and `ZeroFalseAccept P Q` hold, then `warnAdjudicateGate Q adj` achieves both `ZeroLockout P` and `ZeroFalseAccept P` (`warnAdjudicateGate_zeroLockout_and_sound`).

hypotheses.name: hvalid : P x₀
hypotheses.purpose: supplies a semantically valid artifact `x₀` so rejecting `x₀` constitutes a genuine lockout rather than a sound rejection
hypotheses.witness_class: `P = (· = true)` and exact `Q = id` at invalid `x₀ = false`, where `Q false = false` yet `ZeroLockout P (blockingGate Q)` holds

hypotheses.name: hproxy : Q x₀ = false
hypotheses.purpose: witnesses strictness of the proxy check `Q` rejecting the valid artifact `x₀`
hypotheses.witness_class: `P = (· = true)` and exact `Q = id` at `x₀ = true`, where `P true` holds and `ZeroLockout P (blockingGate Q)` holds

hypotheses.name: hadj : ExactAdjudicatorOnWarnings P Q adj
hypotheses.purpose: ensures warned inputs (`Q x = false`) are neither falsely locked out nor falsely accepted by `adj`
hypotheses.witness_class: `P = (· = true)`, `Q = fun _ => false`, and `adj = fun _ => false`, which satisfies `ZeroFalseAccept P Q` yet violates `ZeroLockout`

hypotheses.name: hfast : ZeroFalseAccept P Q
hypotheses.purpose: ensures inputs accepted immediately on the `Q x = true` fast path (bypassing `adj`) satisfy `P`
hypotheses.witness_class: `P = (· = true)`, `Q = fun _ => true`, and `adj = id`, where `ExactAdjudicatorOnWarnings` holds vacuously yet `false` is falsely accepted

nonvacuity_witness: `nonvacuity_exact_blockingGate` and `nonvacuity_warnAdjudicate_strict_proxy`: exact `Q = (· == 0)` for `P = (· = 0)` satisfies both sides of `zeroLockout_and_zeroFalseAccept_iff_exact`, while strict proxy `Q = (· == 0)` for `P = (· % 2 = 0)` rejects valid `x₀ = 2` and is repaired by `warnAdjudicateGate Q (· % 2 == 0)`.
non_claims: `warnAdjudicateGate_zeroLockout_and_sound` requires `ZeroFalseAccept P Q` (`∀ x, Q x = true → P x`) on the unwarned fast path (`cex_warnAdjudicate_without_sound_fastPath`): a heuristic `Q` that silently passes invalid artifacts (`Q x = true ∧ ¬ P x`) cannot skip adjudication without false acceptances.

`ExactAdjudicatorOnWarnings P Q adj` assumes a total boolean function `adj : α → Bool` that decides `P` without error on every warned input (`Q x = false`). When `P` is undecidable or when human or automated adjudication is fallible or partial (abstaining on hard instances), no total boolean `adj` satisfies `ExactAdjudicatorOnWarnings` (`cex_warnAdjudicate_without_exact_adjudicator`, undecidability not proved here).
Latency, human/computational cost of `adj`, and warning volume (`|{x | Q x = false}|`) are not modeled.
